Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-6791.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

443-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1495-6593-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1495-6593-7803.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Brad Boimler.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6593-7803.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

670-1603-1619-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.

80-1618-2440-7110.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

Activate Codie by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.

Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.

Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.
